correctness.rationale: For exactly F3, independently rebuilt 13 rational projective lines, 15 quartic monomials, 26 scalar-nonzero binary-quadratic squares. Fresh independent C++ enumeration checked every one of 7,174,453 scalar-normalized equations (histogram 0..13 equal to the source counts), yielded all 2,782 forms with >=8 bitangents. A separately coded orbit action verifies the five generators yield all 5,616 PGL3(F3) elements; 2,782 candidates split into seven orbits of sizes 13,39,78,234,312,702,1404, with unique smooth orbit size 312 at 10 rational bitangents. Six other orbit representatives have an explicit singular rational point. Geometric smoothness of F=X^3Z-XZ^3+Y^4-Y^2 Z^2+Z^4 follows from Fx=-Z^3,Fy=Y^3+YZ^2,Fz=X^3+Y^2 Z+Z^3 with no common projective zero. Direct fresh F3 evaluation confirms one rational curve point [1:0:0], and exactly 3 nonbitangent rational lines Y=0,Y+Z=0,Y-Z=0 through it. The finite exhaustive search truly covers exactly the claimed finite field; no extrapolation to larger fields.
